title: feat: register endpoint agents through API
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `POST /account/my-models/endpoint-agents` with a strict endpoint-agent-only Zod body
- Stores no bearer credential, pricing, modality, or fallbacks; the server assigns `endpoint_agent`
- Defaults registrations to private and reuses the existing publishing allowlist for public agents
- Adds the integration regression suite to required Enter CI

Related: #13623. Dashboard and `polli` creation are intentionally separate follow-ups.

Tests: Enter CI set, 102/102; Enter TypeScript; Biome; `git diff --check`.

gist.headline: Agents find the front door
gist.blurb: Endpoint agents can now register themselves through the API, without carrying a suitcase full of credentials or pricing fields. Private by default; public when the existing garden gate says yes.
gist.summary: Added POST /account/my-models/endpoint-agents with a strict endpoint-agent-only Zod body; registrations omit bearer credentials, pricing, modality, and fallbacks, default to private, and use the existing publishing allowlist for public agents.
gist.impact: Developers can register endpoint agents directly through the API with server-assigned endpoint_agent type and the same public-publishing policy already used elsewhere.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a friendly API gardener at a small garden gate labeled ENDPOINT AGENTS, welcoming tiny boxed-up agent sprouts through a clearly marked POST doorway. A cozy allowlist sign controls the sunny public garden beyond, while most newly planted agents begin in a private greenhouse; include a retro terminal and code-plants to represent structured API registration.
